column1: # Starter deck: the sixteen Amharic songs the game was first built with, in September
# 2026. Their years were written down unverified then. On 26 October 2026 each was checked
# against a documented release, and the note beside it says where the year comes from; a
# note that starts with "confirmed" imports its row as confirmed. Deezer track ids were
# added so that importing this file needs no network.
# year <TAB> artist_latin <TAB> title_latin <TAB> artist_am <TAB> title_am <TAB> youtube_url <TAB> deezer_track_id <TAB> # note

column8: # confirmed · Amha single AE 190 (Mote Adeladayou / Yekermo Saw), 1969 (Discogs 4948090); the Éthiopiques 4 booklet dates it 1969.
# confirmed · Amha LP Ethiopian Modern Instrumentals Hits (AELP 10), June 1972, per the Éthiopiques 4 booklet (Discogs 2055359).
# confirmed · Kaifa Records 1975: single KF 22 and the LP LPKF 20 (Discogs 5273500, 5198041); the Éthiopiques 7 reissue dates the Kaifa tracks 1975.
# confirmed · Kaifa single KF 24 and the LP LPKF 20, 1975 (Discogs 5273055, 5198041); Éthiopiques 7: Kaifa 1975. Was 1974.
# confirmed · Kaifa Records single KF 37 (Tashamanalech / Wube Alem), 1976 (Discogs 8249950), inside the 1973–77 span of Éthiopiques 13. Was 1969.

# confirmed · Girma Beyene's instrumental; its earliest known release is the Walias Band's, on Tche Belew, Kaifa LPKF 45, 1977 (Discogs 5217597), also on Éthiopiques 13. Was 1970. Deezer plays his 2017 recording with Akalé Wubé.

# confirmed · Yekfir Engurguro closes Lala Belu, Awesome Tapes From Africa, released 9 March 2018 (Discogs 11616930; Deezer); not on Shemonmuanaye, Tche Belew, Tezeta or Wede Harer Guzo. Was 1977. Deezer plays it from a 2020 DJ mix.

# was 1966: Mirkuzz on YouTube dates it Megabit 1972 E.C. (March 1980), lyrics Ayele Mamo, Walias Band, published by Kokeb Music Shop; not among his 1960s-70s singles on Discogs. A 1980s-era cassette song, not a 1960s one. Ethiopian-calendar date from one curator.
# confirmed · Aster LP, Triple Earth 1989 (Columbia 1990), Discogs master 430076.

# was 1991: track B1 of her Kaifa cassette ቁጥር 5 with Shebele Band (Tango Music Shop; Discogs master 2896930; Mainz 'Hode telemenegn'), one of the five Ali Tango cassettes made before she left for the US in 1981 (Wikipedia). No year on the cover; 1979 is an estimate within 1977-81.
# confirmed · Deezer single Na'et 2022-06-23; Teddy Afro's YouTube channel uploaded 'Naet (Eyamemew No. 2) - New! Official Single 2022' with lyrics on 2022-06-21.
# confirmed · Deezer album Etorika 2026-04-17; official lyrics video 'Das Tal (Ansaw) | Track 1' on Teddy Afro's YouTube channel uploaded 2026-04-16.

# confirmed · Was 2013. English Wikipedia says Zeritu's debut album Zeritu came out in September 2005 and names Yane on it; iTunes dates the same 12-track album 2005-12-29; YouTube uploads from 2009. Deezer's Atihidibign (2023-03-22) is that album re-uploaded.

# confirmed · Deezer album Sidist (VI) (Universal Music Africa) 2022-07-10; official visualizer on Rophnan's YouTube channel uploaded the same day, 2022-07-10. Keeps the earlier correction of the starter deck's 2019.

# confirmed · Deezer album Betam New Emiwodish (Zefens) 2016-02-02; the album's title track had its Hope Music Ethiopia official video uploaded 2016-03-23. No 2016 upload of this track itself was found.
# confirmed · Was 2018. Deezer single Messay (Independent) 2020-09-26; official video on Abby Lakew's channel uploaded 2020-09-10; English Wikipedia says Lakew released "Messay" on 10 September 2020.
